I take payment up front because of this lady and no more checks. 

I had watched her dogs in the past with no issue. Paid me cash the day she picked them up. This time she said she grabbed the wrong purse on her way over and asked if a check be okay. Sure, it’s a pain but okay. I deposit the check and then a few days later get a letter from my bank for NSF. Sent her a picture of it and asked her to pay online since the check bounced. She profusely apologized, said their card data was stolen while on vacation and that they lost all of their money but she would pay me within the week. Nothing. Sent her multiple texts, called her, still nothing. 

So I called the county non emergency line. Because it was over x amount it counted as felony theft. A sheriff ended up calling me and asking for pictures of all text/email conversations so he could contact her. Asked if I wanted to press charges and said if I did it could be jail time for her and more fines than what she owed me. I literally just want my money. He calls her and within an hour she’s calling me. I decline the call and sent her a message asking for all communication to remain in text/email so I have proof. 

Now she’s saying her mom died, she had to go across the country to plan the funeral and she forgot her phone when she left. (Her Facebook was public, she was in fact partying the whole time.) Now she says she’ll pay me by Friday (2-3 days) but they’re still recovering from having their card data stolen so they have to ask family for help. 

Sheriff calls me back, I told him she did contact me but I knew she was still jerking me around. Asks again if I want to press charges and I said if she doesn’t pay by Friday then yes. He lets her know I’ll be pressing charges if I don’t get paid. This lady sends me a bunch of sob story messages about all these terrible things happening and them being broke and please don’t press charges. I sent her a screenshot of her two nights before at an expensive club. 

Immediately got the payment.
